  - faq:
    - header: 1. Will I receive a course certificate?
      body: Yes, if you meet the attendance, practical exercise, and group project requirements.
    - header: 2. Can I join late or leave early?
      body: Contact us in advance, and we can discuss on a case-by-case basis.
    - header: 3. What if I get sick during the course?
      body: Tell us and stay home until you feel better. We will help minimize the impact on your learning where possible. Contact us if you need assistance.
    - header: 4. Can you accommodate dietary requirements?
      body: List your dietary requirements on the registration form. We will inform the restaurant, which offers alternatives and can prepare special meals when needed.
    - header: 5. What if I experience discrimination or harassment?
      body: Tell an organizer or staff member immediately if you experience or witness harassment, discrimination, or other inappropriate behavior. See the [NBIS Training Code of Conduct](home_coc.qmd).
